title: Bombsquad Allay
description: If you feel like Allays don't do enough, give them some TNT and a target
body:
Do you ever feel like Allays don't do enough?

Give them some TNT and a target to give them a purpose.

Use a Goat Horn with the Seek noise in order to make nearby Allays with TNT's fly towards the target.

To skip manually giving Allays TNT, put a chest down with TNT in it and they will go ahead and grab it by themselves.

Allays exploding might not work great on the Ender-Dragon, so use this mod for other purposes.

*I am not sure if I will provide more features to the mod or update it to other versions yet*
